In the first fast classic game of Total Chess World Championship Tour Pilot, Women's World Championship Challenger Vaishali Rameshbabu was up against one of the best players in the World, Maxime Vachier-Lagrave. Check out this very interesting pawn endgame they played, with the commentary of Sagar Shah!
